Estimate detector delay by cross-correlation

dot-estimate_delay_xcorr.Rd

Estimate detector delay by cross-correlation

Usage

.estimate_delay_xcorr(fid, tic, max_delay, step)

Arguments

fid, tic

Lists with numeric rt and intensity (min).

max_delay

Numeric; largest delay magnitude searched (min).

step

Numeric; common grid spacing (min).

Value

A list with delay (min; positive when MS times are later than FID times) and score (normalised correlation at the best lag).

Details

Both traces are linearly interpolated onto a common grid over their overlapping range, baseline-corrected and cross-correlated over lags within max_delay. The peak is refined by a parabola through the best lag and its neighbours.
